interpretation: The raw archive contains proven byte-identical duplicates.
Random image-level train/validation splitting can place identical files on both sides and inflate validation accuracy.
dHash matches are candidates, not proof of duplicate biological specimens; they require visual review.
The previous 92.99% same-source validation result must not be treated as independent phone-photo performance.
required_next_steps: Collapse exact duplicate groups before splitting.
Group related frames by plant specimen/capture sequence where possible.
Split by specimen or capture group, not by individual file.
Keep an independent indoor phone-photo test set.
Retrain and report top-1 and confusion matrix only after the leakage-safe split.
training_status: No new disease/condition class or photo was accepted by this audit.
